Short title, extent and commencement

ACT I OF 1973
ACT I OF 1973
SIND FINANCE ACT, 1973
An Act to levy or enhance certain taxes and duties in the Province of
Sind
[Gazette of Sind,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 29th June 1973]
(First published after having
received the assent of the Governor of Sind in the Gazette of Sind
(Extra-ordinary), dated 28th June 1973).
No. PAS Legis-B-13/73.--The
Sind Finance Bill, 1973 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sind
on the 27th June 1973 and assented to by the Governor of Sind on the 28th June
1973 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sind :-
1. Short title, extent and commencement.-(1) This Act may be called
the Sind Finance Act, 1973.
(2) It extends to the whole
Province of Sind.
(3) It shall come into force on
and from the 1st day of July 1973.

2. Definitions.--In this Act, unless the context otherwise
requires, the following expressions shall have the meanings hereby respectively
assigned to them, that is to say-
(a)
"Government" means the Government of Sind;
(b)
"prescribed" means prescribed by rules made under this Act.

3. Amendment of section 3 of West Pakistan Act V of 1958.--In the
Sind Urban Immovable Property Tax Act, 1958 (West Pakistan Act V of 1958), in
section 3-
(a) in
subsection (2) for the word "paid", the word "collected"
shall be substituted and shall be deemed to have always been so substituted.
(b) after
subsection (3), the following new subsection shall be inserted, namely :-
"(3-A)
There shall be levied and collected a betterment tax on buildings and lands
used partly or exclusively for commercial or industrial purposes at the
following scale--
(i) Plot for Commercial purpose
Ten paisa per square foot of
covered area.
(ii) Plot for Industrial
purpose
Five paisa per square foot of
covered area.
(3-B) A plat for commercial
purpose measuring up to 120 square yards and a plot for industrial purpose
measuring up to 400 square yards in any rating area or part thereof shall be
exempt from the tax under sub-section (3-A)".

8. Par of suits in civil
Courts.---No suit shall lie in any civil Court to set aside or modify any
assessment, levy or collection of the taxes and cesses made under this Act and
the rules framed thereunder.

may make rules for carrying into effect the purposes of this Act and such rules
may among other matters, prescribe the procedure for toe assessment, collection
and payment of the taxes and cesses levied tinder this Act.
